summary: Implemented the CLI plus Skill operation entrypoint and separated workflow run fixtures from runnable examples. A standard-harness preflight run was attempted first and failed closed because the optional Codex SDK driver dependency is not installed in this workstation.

standard_harness_preflight.finding: CodexSDKDriver resolved through the registry, but execution failed closed with RuntimeError("CodexSDKDriver requires the optional 'codex' extra: pip install -e .[codex]").

changes: Added src/ahra/cli.py with workflow validate/start/inspect/resume, task inspect, evidence-gate evaluate, and doctor commands.
Registered the ahra console script in pyproject.toml.
Added CLI tests covering validation, start fail-closed behavior, explicit fixture-driver smoke start, workflow inspect, task inspect, and doctor dry-run.
Moved fake-reference workflow run examples under examples/workflow_runs/fixtures/.
Updated Skill, README, entrypoint, driver, runtime, roadmap, schema-test, and lint-contract references to the CLI plus Skill path.

commands.notes: AHRA lint passed and 51 unittest tests passed.
No whitespace errors; Git reported CRLF normalization warnings only.
Validated fixture request using fake-reference as a fixture-only driver ref.
Validated runnable Codex SDK request shape.
Returned the local doctor command list.

acceptance_mapping.notes: CLI commands call existing local APIs: reference runner, EvidenceGate, task inspection, and check scripts.
skills/ahra-workflow-runner/SKILL.md names the CLI commands agents should use.
Default docs and Skill route point to CLI plus Skill. MCP is described as legacy optional and not used for new workflow operation.
Workflow run examples are split into fixtures and runnable directories; fixture driver requires --enable-fixture-driver in CLI smoke tests.
This implementation report, manifests, events, state update, and handoff are being published for review.

known_limits: This task did not make CodexSDKDriver usable on this workstation because the optional openai_codex package is not installed.
MCP code and tests remain present as legacy optional coverage; this task removes it from the default route rather than deleting the adapter.
